name: business logic and money
owns: the rules an organisation applies to value: pricing, discounts, refunds, inventory, auctions, betting, advertising, referrals and subscriptions
why_in_D: This is where most real impact lands, and it is the lens almost no security list covers, because it cannot be found by a scanner. There is no malformed request. The request is valid, the code runs as written, and the rule it implements is simply wrong when applied in an order or quantity the designer did not imagine. A vulnerability scanner finds none of it.

factors.name: price source authority
factors.def: whether the charged price is read from the catalogue or accepted from the request
factors.observable: an order completed at a client supplied price

factors.name: price recomputation point
factors.def: where the total is finally calculated, and whether that point revalidates every input
factors.observable: a total differing from the sum of its parts

factors.name: currency and minor unit handling
factors.def: whether amounts are integer minor units and whether conversion truncates in a favourable direction
factors.observable: a repeated fractional gain across many orders

factors.name: rounding direction and repetition
factors.def: which way fractions round and whether repeating the operation accumulates value
factors.observable: a balance that grows by repetition with no legitimate cause

factors.name: negative quantity acceptance
factors.def: whether a negative or zero quantity is accepted where a positive is assumed
factors.observable: a credit created by a negative line item

factors.name: quantity overflow
factors.def: whether large quantities overflow a fixed width total or a stock check
factors.observable: a total wrapping to a small or negative value

factors.name: discount stacking rules
factors.def: whether multiple discounts can apply to one item, and in which order
factors.observable: a combined discount exceeding the stated maximum

factors.name: coupon reuse and idempotency
factors.def: whether a single use coupon is enforced atomically
factors.observable: a coupon redeemed more than its limit

factors.name: coupon scope enforcement
factors.def: whether a coupon is restricted to the intended products, users or channels
factors.observable: a coupon applied outside its scope

factors.name: coupon application order
factors.def: whether discount order changes the result, and whether the best order is computed server side
factors.observable: an order of operations that reduces the total more than intended

factors.name: gift card and store credit as money
factors.def: whether stored value is treated with the same controls as payment
factors.observable: value created or transferred without payment

factors.name: refund without return
factors.def: whether a refund can complete while the goods remain with the buyer
factors.observable: a refund recorded with no return state change

factors.name: partial refund accumulation
factors.def: whether repeated partial refunds can exceed the original amount
factors.observable: refund total above the order total

factors.name: chargeback and dispute state
factors.def: whether the system tracks dispute state or keeps granting access after a reversal
factors.observable: access retained after a reversed payment

factors.name: payment webhook trust
factors.def: whether a payment confirmation is verified as originating from the provider
factors.observable: an order marked paid by a forged event

factors.name: webhook replay and ordering
factors.def: whether events are deduplicated and whether out of order delivery corrupts state
factors.observable: a duplicate or reordered event producing a second effect

factors.name: payment amount matching
factors.def: whether the settled amount is compared against the expected total
factors.observable: an order fulfilled for an amount that does not match

factors.name: trial and grace period abuse
factors.def: whether a trial can be restarted by changing an identifier
factors.observable: a second trial for the same principal under a new key

factors.name: subscription proration arithmetic
factors.def: whether mid cycle upgrade and downgrade proration can be sequenced for gain
factors.observable: a net credit from a rapid up and down cycle

factors.name: plan downgrade data retention
factors.def: whether data beyond the new plan's limit is deleted or merely hidden
factors.observable: over limit data still readable after downgrade

factors.name: seat and licence counting
factors.def: whether seats are counted at invite, accept or active use, and which can be dodged
factors.observable: more active users than paid seats

factors.name: quota reset semantics
factors.def: whether a quota resets on a boundary that can be straddled for double allowance
factors.observable: two allowances inside one intended window

factors.name: inventory reservation versus decrement
factors.def: when stock is decremented, which decides oversell through abandoned carts or concurrency
factors.observable: more units sold than existed

factors.name: inventory race on checkout
factors.def: whether the final decrement is atomic
factors.observable: two confirmations for the last unit

factors.name: backorder and negative stock acceptance
factors.def: whether stock can go negative and whether that is later fulfilled at the old price
factors.observable: a negative stock level accepted

factors.name: shipping cost calculation source
factors.def: whether shipping is recomputed server side against the real destination and weight
factors.observable: shipping charged below cost for a chosen destination

factors.name: tax calculation and jurisdiction
factors.def: whether tax is computed from a verified address and whether a claimed exemption is validated
factors.observable: zero tax applied without an entitlement

factors.name: auction bid ordering and sniping window
factors.def: whether the closing time and bid ordering are server authoritative
factors.observable: a bid accepted after close or ordered wrongly

factors.name: auction reserve and shill behaviour
factors.def: whether the system prevents a seller bidding on their own lot
factors.observable: a bid from the seller's own principal

factors.name: betting odds lock timing
factors.def: whether odds are locked at acceptance or at settlement
factors.observable: a bet settled at odds it was not accepted at

factors.name: betting cash out arithmetic
factors.def: whether a cash out value can be gamed by rapid state changes
factors.observable: a cash out above the fair value of the position

factors.name: random draw and raffle fairness
factors.def: whether the draw is verifiable and whether entry counts can be inflated
factors.observable: a draw with manipulable outcome or entry count

factors.name: referral credit on self reference
factors.def: whether a principal can refer itself through a second account
factors.observable: credit earned on a self referral

factors.name: referral credit before conversion
factors.def: whether credit is granted on signup rather than on a qualifying action
factors.observable: credit granted with no downstream value

factors.name: affiliate attribution window
factors.def: whether an affiliate can claim attribution for organic traffic by planting a cookie
factors.observable: commission paid on a conversion they did not drive

factors.name: advertising spend as attacker input
factors.def: whether an ad buyer can influence what is shown to a chosen audience
factors.observable: content served to a narrow audience on demand

factors.name: ad impression and click fraud
factors.def: whether impressions and clicks can be generated cheaply
factors.observable: billable events without a human

factors.name: conversion event forgery
factors.def: whether a conversion is reported from a client that can lie
factors.observable: a conversion recorded with no purchase

factors.name: loyalty point minting
factors.def: whether points can be earned faster than intended by repeating an action
factors.observable: points earned per unit of real value above the rate

factors.name: loyalty point redemption parity
factors.def: whether redeeming and re earning can convert points to cash repeatedly
factors.observable: a net gain from a redemption loop

factors.name: gift and transfer between accounts
factors.def: whether value can move between accounts the attacker controls, laundering origin
factors.observable: value transferred with no legitimate purpose

factors.name: withdrawal versus deposit timing
factors.def: whether a withdrawal can settle against funds that later fail to arrive
factors.observable: a withdrawal completed before the deposit cleared

factors.name: double spend across channels
factors.def: whether the same balance can be used simultaneously through two interfaces
factors.observable: two spends from one balance

factors.name: price change race at checkout
factors.def: whether a price edit between cart and confirmation charges the old or new value, and which is exploitable
factors.observable: an order charged at a price that never coexisted with the stock

factors.name: cart merge on login
factors.def: whether merging a guest cart into an authenticated one can duplicate or drop line items
factors.observable: a cart with duplicated discounts after merge

factors.name: order state machine integrity
factors.def: whether states can be skipped, reversed or re-entered out of order
factors.observable: an order in a state it could not legitimately reach

factors.name: cancellation after fulfilment
factors.def: whether a cancel is honoured after the goods shipped
factors.observable: both a refund and a delivery

factors.name: approval workflow bypass
factors.def: whether a required approval can be skipped by acting on the next step directly
factors.observable: a step completed without its approver

factors.name: four eyes enforcement
factors.def: whether dual control is enforced at the data layer or only in the interface
factors.observable: a transaction approved by one principal

factors.name: limit application across dimensions
factors.def: whether a transfer limit applies per transaction, per day, per principal and globally
factors.observable: a limit bypassed by splitting or by changing dimension

factors.name: velocity checks on new accounts
factors.def: whether a new principal faces stricter limits than an aged one, and whether that is enforceable
factors.observable: full limits available immediately on a new account

factors.name: free tier as a cost channel
factors.def: whether free usage can be expanded by creating principals, which is abuse of the business model
factors.observable: unbounded free usage through account multiplication

factors.name: trial to paid conversion integrity
factors.def: whether a trial end can be dodged by cancelling before a specific step
factors.observable: continued service with no active subscription

factors.name: dunning and access suspension
factors.def: whether access is suspended when payment fails, and how long the grace window is
factors.observable: access retained long after repeated failure

factors.name: invoice and receipt manipulation
factors.def: whether an invoice can be generated with content the buyer controls
factors.observable: a document carrying injected content

factors.name: marketplace seller trust
factors.def: whether a seller can alter platform fees, shipping or buyer protections
factors.observable: a fee below the platform rate

factors.name: escrow release conditions
factors.def: whether funds release on a condition the buyer or seller can fake
factors.observable: release without the stated condition holding

factors.name: review and rating integrity
factors.def: whether ratings can be cast in bulk or by principals with no transaction
factors.observable: ratings from accounts with no purchase

factors.name: content moderation as a business rule
factors.def: whether a moderation decision can be triggered against a competitor, which is abuse not a bug
factors.observable: a takedown produced at scale

factors.name: regulatory limit and reporting
factors.def: whether a transaction threshold can be split to avoid reporting
factors.observable: structured transfers below a threshold

factors.name: pricing experiment assignment
factors.def: whether a user can choose their own experiment bucket and obtain a lower price
factors.observable: bucket assignment influenced by the client

factors.name: time based offer manipulation
factors.def: whether a time limited offer trusts the client clock or a manipulable server state
factors.observable: a lapsed offer still honoured
